[[Colonel]] '''Halland Goth''' was an [[Imperial officer]] who served as the [[commander]] of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard]]. Shortly after the [[proclamation of the New Order]] transitioned the [[Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], Colonel Goth was present at a [[celebration marking the eradication of the Jedi Order]], standing guard behind [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]]. Not long after, Goth and a [[Halland Goth's squad|squad]] were placed under the command of [[Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Vader]], [[emissary]] of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], for a [[mission to Diso]].<ref name="Master of Evil" />
